title: Zero-Copy Tokenizer with Lifetimes
prompt:
Write a tokenizer that borrows from its input and yields string slices without allocating.

Tokenizer<'a> holds a &'a str and implements Iterator<Item = Token<'a>>. Tokens are:
- Token::Number(&'a str): a maximal run of ASCII digits
- Token::Ident(&'a str): a maximal run starting with an ASCII letter or '_' followed by ASCII letters, digits or '_'
- Token::Symbol(char): any other single non-whitespace character
Whitespace is skipped.

Each yielded slice must point into the original input (no String allocation). The lifetime on Token ties the output to the input, so tokens can outlive the Tokenizer itself.

Also implement idents(src) that returns all identifier slices in src, in order.

Example:
  Tokenizer::new("x1 = 42+y") yields
    Ident("x1"), Symbol('='), Number("42"), Symbol('+'), Ident("y")
